decisions.reason: Although the portal is not a core paper product and is only mentioned on the website, its recent launch and some public commitment lead management to give it more time.
The German Packaging Award is a clear success that reinforces the firm's public commitment, making discontinuation very unlikely.
Its own website page signals visible commitment, and early results can still be attributed to temporary market conditions.
The dedicated page shows the firm has invested in presenting the product, and management is likely to justify continuing it.
As a large freestanding display, it represents substantial investment and public commitment, so escalation favors keeping it.
